# rixl_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an IAM access policy to a user within a Rixl organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_policy_attachment" "user_editor" {
  org_id    = var.rixl_org_id
  policy_id = rixl_access_policy.editor.id
  user_id   = "usr_01h7abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity_id` (String)
- `identity_type` (String)
- `org_id` (String)
- `policy_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
